experiment_data.hypothesis: GPT-2-medium (355M) under r=0.25 mixing exhibits Type II trajectory (transient EMA dip at Gen 1-2 followed by monotonic SLV recovery), verifying that the critical mixing ratio r_crit phase boundary holds cross-architecture. Combined with exp_020 (Type I at r=0) and exp_022c (Type III at r=0.3), this completes the GPT-2-medium phase diagram and confirms r_crit ∈ (0.25, 0.3] is architecture-independent.
experiment_data.notes: GPT-2-medium r=0.25 3-gen pilot 完成。Type II trajectory 确认：SLV Gen 1→2 下降 1.85% (748.06→734.21, dip=-13.85)，Gen 2→3 恢复 +0.50% (734.21→737.91)。与 Pythia-410M r=0.25 定性一致，支持 r_crit ∈ (0.25, 0.3] 架构无关。GPT-2-medium 初始谱极度集中 (eff_rank=23 vs Pythia=417)，decompression transient 更剧烈。产出: artifacts/exp_023/analysis_report.md
